R1: strict majority of evaluable primary Oracle structure bank-rows with full-pool probe >= .90 meet mention <= .05 and all-silent probe >= .85; zero eligible rows => NOT EVALUABLE
dedup: within bank, row, reader, layer, arm: item id and exact raw text; no wrapper cleanup
detector: E24 statement for its 19 structure rows; otherwise existing §107 rater-1 pass-A codes only
missing_policy: no imputation; incomplete detector coverage or missing matching probes makes row NOT EVALUABLE for R1
probe_orientation: value A positive; sealed true (not mismatched) probe predictions at reader block; no refit
silent_descriptive: unique items with at least one silent readout
silent_primary: unique items with every deduplicated readout silent
value_correct: (correct-only minus wrong-only) / deduplicated readouts; both/unclear mentions contribute zero
